note.question: What determines the design and distribution of cause-linked products?
note.overview: In a cause marketing (CM) campaign, a firm donates part of its sales revenue to a charity for a social cause when customers purchase the cause-linked product. This paper studies a firm’s pricing decisions with CM and the implications for the participating charity. We also consider the design and distribution of cause-linked products.
